title: Notebook storage: SQLite
content: SQLite keeps the notebook available offline without a database service. Use a single writer.

title: Cache expiry policy
content: Cache entries expire after one day.

title: Cache expiry policy
content: Cache entries expire after one hour because readers observed stale values.

title: Temporary tracing experiment
content: Enable verbose tracing during the temporary experiment only.

title: Compression recommendation
content: Team A recommends enabling compression to reduce transfer bytes.

title: Compression recommendation
content: Team B recommends disabling compression to reduce CPU usage. This disagreement is unresolved.

title: SQLite for the private service
content: SQLite configuration from a different scope must not appear in notebook retrieval.
